title: Argala Stotram
author: Durga Saptashati, recited before chapter 1
intro: Argala means a bolt or latch: this stotra is the key that opens the Durga Saptashati, recited before its thirteen chapters. Most verses recall one of the Goddess's victories and end with the refrain रूपं देहि जयं देहि यशो देहि द्विषो जहि, 'give me beauty, give me victory, give me glory, destroy my enemies'.
note: Verses follow the commonly printed text (Gita Press numbering may differ by a verse or two).
